title: faux fur white/ivory blanket
text: faux fur white/ivory blanket. This blanket is not a "throw"... it is a full size blanket.... which I like.  When I get cozy with a blanket for a quick nap or for comfort, I want it to cover me... including toes - so this is good for me.  But to be fair, it is in no way a "throw" size at 90"x90". It fits on my queen size bed easily as a full blanket.  It is 100% polyester.  It machine washed and dried nicely and I don't have a fancy washing machine and dryer.  To me, the "sherpa" side is actually a lot softer than the "fur" side.  I have included a couple of pictures... it is a light, soft ivory color in my opinion, no yellow tones - but not fully white.  I took a pic with my quilt which has white in it so you can kind of compare the color. It is what I would consider a medium weight when on you.. not super thick, but plenty warm and cozy. Having said that, it is quite heavy holding it all in one arm full.  I prefer the "sherpa" size to my skin.  The "fur" side does have a slight "swirl" effect in pattern.  It is my opinion that you will want to carefully care for this blanket so you don't have to wash it too many times...I think the sherpa side may become lumpy and pilly... time will tell. I always try to answer all questions and comments...further, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful in any way.

product_metadata.title: DaDa Bedding Champagne Ivory Faux Fur Throw Blanket - Dreamy Gold Geometric Embossed Sherpa Backside - Super Soft Warm Cozy Plush Fluffy - 63" x 90"
features: Features champagne ivory geometric herringbone pattern on a light golden background on the front side of the sherpa throw blanket. Decorative and Eye candy.
The backside is completely white with the same sherpa material to compliment and give it extra comfort and softness. Perfect for Bed, Couch, or Sofa. Snuggle buddy.

Lovely addition to any sleeping or lounging space - Ideal for all year round climates Living room or Bedroom- Especially perfect for colder climates due to the soft & warm fleece material on both sides of blanket.
Throw Blanket Material - PV Fleece 280 GSM and Sherpa 240 GSM – Face: 100% Polyester – Back: 100% Polyester | Ultra Snuggly.
Washing Care Instructions - Easy Wash, Machine Wash Cold w/ Like Colors, No Harsh Chemicals, Line to Air Dry for Best Results or Tumble Dry Low No Heat.
Perfect Gift Idea: Housewarming, Graduation, Anniversary, Birthday, etc. For Vacation Houses, Logs, Cabins, Farmhouses, etc. Twin / Single Size | 63x90 Reversible.
